excerpts.author: paulhauner
excerpts.content:
at the moment we maintain two separate pools:

- naive aggregation pool: only contains unaggregated attestations (i.e., from shard subnets)
- block inclusion pool: only contains aggregated attestations (i.e., from the global subnet)

If we don't get an aggregate then we don't attempt to produce one from naive aggregation pool

excerpts.author: paulhauner
excerpts.content: We plan to fix this in the future.. for profit maximization, but it's not a priority at the moment.

excerpts.author: paulhauner
excerpts.content: So, keen to keep an eye on it whilst the validator numbers increase. With the current active validator count of 30 and the spec constants set as they are, we're unlikely to see many aggregators.
